versions.changelog: Fix credits/billing flow docs, correct node_type endpoint path, add credit-blocked run handling workflow

- Added detailed setup and usage instructions for the Mosaic API key, including one-click setup guidance.
- Expanded documentation links for specific workflows: managing agents, running edits, uploading assets, social publishing, and credit management.
- Provided an overview of agent nodes ("tiles") with API methods for discovery and linked per-node reference files.
- Listed editing best practices and important guardrails for agent parameter customization.
- Included an endpoint map for quick reference to API documentation.
